contracts.rule: Pin revision; validate header/body agreement and required per-request metadata; authorize explicit handles independently of connection identity.
Integrity-protect consequential continuation state; bind principal, operation and expiry; separately enforce one-time consumption when needed.
Treat disconnect/cancellation as stopping request processing, not evidence that a side effect rolled back; reconcile unknown outcomes with application idempotency.
Keep private results scoped to authorization context; exclude continued MRTR responses; TTL does not establish transactional freshness.

contracts.rule: Pin spec patch 1.0.1 while transmitting 1.0; advertise explicit interfaces; isolate 0.3 migration.
Keep task, message and context identifiers separate; terminal tasks do not restart; expose durable output as artifacts.
Stream disconnect does not cancel work; reconnect by reconciling current task and artifacts, not assuming replay of every missed message.
SendMessage deduplication is optional; define application operation identity and recovery separately.
Authenticate and scope task reads, lists, cancellation, subscriptions and notification configuration; remote text is untrusted data.
Declare retention, restore and executor recovery independently of protocol Task persistence.
